## EmptyState.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `icon` :: An icon drawn above the title.
- `title` :: The heading, such as "No deployments yet".
- `description` :: A short explanation, set under the title.
- `size` :: The scale of the icon.
- `pad` :: The inset around the icon, the text block and the actions.
- `gap` :: The space between the icon, the text block and the actions.
- `alignContent` :: Horizontal placement of the stack inside the placeholder.
- `measure` :: The width of the text block.
- `textSize` :: Text scale on the shared text ladder.
- `textColor` :: Ink of the icon. Defaults to `text-muted`.
- `childTextColor` :: Ink of the description and the body. Defaults to `text-secondary`.
- `frame` :: An optional frame around the block: a hairline, or a dashed one.
- `actions` :: Controls drawn under the description — usually the next action.
- `children` :: Alternative body content; used when `description` is not enough.
